advisor_identified: Michael R. Marrus, professor of history and Holocaust studies at the University of Toronto.

doctorate.title: The Politics of Assimilation: A Study of the French Jewish Community at the Time of the Dreyfus Affair

evidence.says: The University of Toronto Archives finding aid identifies Marrus as a Toronto history professor and states that he received his PhD at the University of California, Berkeley in 1968 (p. 3). It describes his Berkeley PhD thesis with the exact linked title (p. 6), and inventories that thesis as file B2011-0009/001 (06), dated [1968] (p. 11).

The Globe and Mail obituary independently states that Michael Robert Marrus received his MA and PhD from the University of California, Berkeley, and taught modern European history at the University of Toronto for 49 years.

notes: Institution, year and thesis title match linked AHA record 38490. The archival description explicitly identifies this thesis as the Toronto professor’s own Berkeley doctorate; the obituary corroborates the institution but does not give the degree year.
